Search the Antithesis documentation. Use it first for questions about Antithesis concepts, the SDKs, or test setup. Then read the matches with docs_show.

query is literal text. Set match to true to use SQLite FTS5 syntax: AND, OR, NOT, NEAR, "phrases", title:word, prefix*. limit: the maximum number of results (default 10).

Returns a JSON array of {path, title, snippet}, best match first.
